title: GTA 6 Triggers Massive Spike in Spotify Music Streams
description: According to IGN Games, Spotify data reveals massive spikes in streams for music featured in GTA 6, including a Carly Rae Jepsen song over a decade old.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Impact: Spotify Reveals Massive Spikes in Featured Music Streams

The anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI continues to permeate popular culture in unexpected ways. According to recent data from Spotify reported by IGN Games, the music tracks featured in GTA 6 are experiencing massive spikes in streaming numbers on the platform, demonstrating the immense cultural gravity that Rockstar Games' upcoming title commands.

### Over a Decade Later, Old Hits Find New Life

One of the most notable highlights from the streaming data involves a song by Carly Rae Jepsen released over a decade ago. Following its association with GTA 6, the track saw a staggering surge in streams. This phenomenon highlights how powerful the GTA franchise is when it comes to reviving and introducing classic tracks to modern audiences, turning video game soundtracks into potent drivers for the music industry.

### The Legacy of In-Game Radio and Soundtracks

Music has always been the heartbeat of the Grand Theft Auto series. From the iconic 1980s licensed tracks in Vice City to the eclectic radio stations in GTA 5, Rockstar Games has consistently curated soundtracks that define the era and setting of their virtual worlds. While exact full tracklists and station details are still unfolding through official teasers and media coverage, this latest data proves that even a glimpse or a featured snippet is enough to spark massive engagement from the global gaming and music communities.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar Games has always had an unmatched ability to influence popular culture through its curated soundtracks. Seeing a decade-old track skyrocket in streams simply due to its connection to GTA 6 is a testament to the game's staggering reach. It proves that the excitement for the title goes far beyond gameplay mechanics, cementing GTA 6 as a true cultural event before it even launches.
